rows.text: The compilation lists the national executive committee as 'altered' at the Diretório Nacional meeting of 10-11 December 1988, with Luiz Gushiken as Presidente (replacing Olívio Dutra, who heads the committee elected on 17 January 1988); it cites Boletim Nacional nº 41 (December 1988/January 1989) as its source.
